title: Invertibility of the canonical balanced sheaf tensor map
statement: Let $Z$ be a topological space, $R,B$ sheaves of commutative rings on $Z$, and $\alpha:R\to B$ a unital morphism. Let $M$ be a sheaf of $B$-modules and $N$ a sheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put $H=\operatorname{Res}_\alpha$ and $E=B\otimes_R N$, defined by sheafifying the sectionwise extension presheaf [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $p_R,p_B$ for the pure-tensor inclusions into the sheaf tensor products and $\eta$ for the module sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Every $R$-linear sheaf morphism $\varphi:H(M)\otimes_R N\to H(M\otimes_B E)$ satisfying $\varphi(p_R(m,n))=p_B(m,\eta(1\otimes n))$ on every open and every pair of sections is an isomorphism. No flatness or nonzero assumptions are made.

source.place: Tag 08DE, proof, ordinary balanced tensor identity; Tag 0GMW, sheafification tensor comparison

proof.text: Obtain the balanced contraction psi with its formula on m tensor eta(b tensor n).

For phi followed by psi, tensorObjIsoSheafification and the module sheafification adjunction reduce equality to original pure tensors. Apply hphi and the contraction formula with b=1; one_smul gives the identity.

For psi followed by phi, original-section extensionality reduces equality to m tensor eta(b tensor n). The contraction formula followed by hphi gives (b m) tensor eta(1 tensor n). Tensor balancing, B-linearity of the extension sheafification unit, and b*1=b identify this with m tensor eta(b tensor n).
Use the two proved composite identities to supply the inverse required by IsIso phi.

proof_origin.reason: R3 realizes both inverse identities directly in Lean, with a sectionwise balanced contraction and a proved original-section extensionality lemma. The module-level naturality and general two-presheaf tensor/sheafification theorems are not used.

theorem balancedTensorComparison_isIso (α : R ⟶ B)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B)) (N : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 R))
    (φ : (monoidalCategory R).tensorObj ((restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj M) N ⟶
      (restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj
        ((monoidalCategory B).tensorObj M (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N)))
    (hφ : ∀ (W : (Opens Z)ᵒᵖ) (m : M.val.obj W) (n : N.val.obj W),
      φ.val.app W
        ((tensorObjIsoSheafification ((restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj M) N).inv.val.app W
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 R).obj)).unit.app
            (((restrictScalars (𝓻 α)).obj M).val ⊗ N.val)).app W
              (m ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj W] n))) =
      (tensorObjIsoSheafification M (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N)).inv.val.app W
        (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
          (M.val ⊗ (changeOfRings.{u, u, u} α N).val)).app W
            (m ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W]
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
                (changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} α N)).app W
                  ((1 : B.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj W,(α.hom.app W).hom] n)))) :
    IsIso φ
